messages:
ana: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for private deployments (VPC + on‑prem). Need to lock scope and launch criteria before EOW.
kevin: On it. main questions: KMS integration, cert rotation, and whether we require customer-managed NAT/GW vs managed egress.
mira: Customer asks we saw: bring-your-own-KMS, optional outbound proxy, and the ability to run in air‑gapped mode. We should list those as "must have" vs "nice to have". :thinking_face: 
ana: Agreed. Proposal: Must have = KMS support (AWS KMS + GCP KMS initially), TLS cert rotation, basic health endpoints, metrics export (Prom/OTEL), and documented network requirements (ports, CIDR). Nice-to-have = per-customer IP allowlist UI, managed NAT gateway.
kevin: For acceptance criteria, can we make them measurable? e.g.:
- Deployment: can bootstrap a customer VPC with our control plane in <= 30min (when using templates)
- Security: all secrets encrypted with customer KMS; keys never stored in plaintext for >1 minute
- Observability: 99% of request traces include model, route, and customer_id tags
- Reliability: baseline throughput 500 rps per dedicated cluster (N=1) with p95 latency < 180ms for short completions

mira: Love measurable ACs. Also add fallback behavior: if a model variant is unavailable in a private region, control plane should route to a compatible hosted variant only if customer opt-in.
sam_ops: Ops note: on‑prem air‑gapped install will need an offline installer + a signed bundle. We should include an upgrade story and a local health-checker that doesn't call internet.
julie_pm: Customer-driven asks that influence roadmap: large fintech needs HSM-backed keys and audit logs retention 7y, med-healthcare customer needs HIPAA controls and data residency. We should capture which of these are gating for enterprise sales.
ana: Decision options to surface in PRD: 1) Launch subset: VPC-only (no on-prem) in GA 1.0, on‑prem alpha for select customers; 2) Full GA covers both but with limited features (no HSM).
kevin: My preference: VPC-first, on‑prem alpha. HSM and 7y retention is enterprise-only add-on. Keeps initial scope manageable.
mira: Edge cases to document:
- Customer blocks outbound to our control plane mid-run (how do we surface alerts?)
- DNS split‑horizon where internal model endpoints resolve differently
- Slow customer NAT causing high tail latency for token fetches
- Partial config drift during rolling upgrades (some nodes out-of-sync)

sam_ops: For the control plane handshake we need explicit retry windows and an offline mode where model serving keeps working with pinned config for X hours if control plane unreachable. Add acceptance: pinned config active >= 72h with degraded telemetry.
julie_pm: Launch criteria checklist suggestion:
- Security review complete (internal + external pen-test)
- 2 pilot customers onboarded & SLA page signed
- Runbook + rollback tested and rehearsed
- Monitoring thresholds and alerting playbooks in place
- Pricing model for Dedicated & Private documented

ana: Draft config snippet for VPC peering notes (add to PRD):
```
network: {
  mode: "vpc-peering",
  required_ports: [443, 8443, 9090],
  cidr_whitelist: ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```
kevin: Minor ask: add explicit DNS requirements and recommend using conditional forwarders for split-horizon. Also we should call out MTU/path MTU issues for on‑prem with VPNs.
mira: Can we call out metrics we need from the customer side for SLO validation? e.g., egress bandwidth, average RTT to our peered subnet, and failed connection rate.
sam_ops: Action items:
- kevin: write detailed networking acceptance criteria (due Tue)
- mira: draft KMS/HSM integration section + threat model (due Wed)
- ana: assemble PRD skeleton + ACs and circulate (due Thu)
- julie_pm: prioritize pilot customers and update sales checklist (due Fri)

deploy-bot: integration-tests/private-deploy-e2e passed (12/14) — failing on cert-rotation integration tests.
kevin: Nice. that aligns — cert rotation failure is ours to debug before pilot.
mira: One more edge case: customer using nonstandard cipher suites; include fallback policy (we'll list supported ciphers) and test matrix.
julie_pm: OK team — I'll book a 45min sync tomorrow to finalize scope and publish PRD for async review. Please finish action items. :thumbsup: :calendar: 
ana: Thanks — I'll post PRD link here when ready and tag for reviews. :eyes:
